projects.title: qrate
projects.organization: Open source · COMP 440 Directed Studies, University of the Fraser Valley
projects.description: An open-source desktop cataloguing app for archives, libraries and museums: a spreadsheet-style grid that validates metadata as it is typed, with each record's scans, documents and video beside it. Used by the South Asian Studies Institute at UFV on its real archival collections.
details: Used by the South Asian Studies Institute's research assistants to catalogue collections for the South Asian Canadian Digital Archive; their feedback drives the roadmap
330+ release downloads, shipped through the Microsoft Store, a Homebrew tap and signed in-app updates
Validates as you type: LCSH, Wikidata and GeoNames authority checks, EDTF dates, missing linked files and spelling, shown as squiggles and in a Problems panel
15-crate Rust workspace on GPUI (the UI framework behind the Zed editor), smooth on ~2,000-row collections backed by scans
Sandboxed Luau plugin system with a signed plugin registry; the Islandora plugin checks columns against a live repository's vocabularies
Optional AI review through a read-only agent bridge: an agent can stage findings but never writes a cell
AGPL-3.0, with contributions from 4 other developers

projects.title: Islandora contributions
projects.description: Contributing upstream fixes to Islandora, the open-source Drupal-based repository platform, found while moving the South Asian Canadian Digital Archive onto it.
details: isle-buildkit: found and fixed animated GIFs producing no derivatives in the Houdini image service (issue #609, PR #610)
islandora_dxpr: print stylesheet so researchers can print an item or collection record for citation (PR #44)
qrate's Islandora plugin brings a live Islandora site's vocabularies into cataloguing

projects.title: Islandora Workbench GUI
projects.organization: South Asian Studies Institute, University of the Fraser Valley
projects.description: A Rust desktop front end for Islandora Workbench, the command-line tool for bulk-loading content into Islandora 2, built for the institute's archive migration. Its reusable pieces became the foundation of qrate.

projects.title: harness-picker
projects.description: `hpick`: one fzf pick to start a new Claude Code, Codex or pi chat, or resume one from the current folder. Built to run from Zed's terminal.
details: Published to Homebrew, Scoop and WinGet with prebuilt release binaries

projects.title: Pokeforge
projects.description: Generates MCP servers from browser automation: it explores a website with Stagehand, writes an MCP server for the actions it found, tests it in a Cloudflare Sandbox and publishes it to GitHub, so the Poke assistant can use sites that have no API.

projects.title: Booksplore
projects.description: Developed a winning website called Booksplore as part of a codejam, using Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and Python. Implemented responsive web design and RESTful APIs for data retrieval.
details: Full-stack development with Vue.js and FastAPI

projects.title: Timeline of Discriminatory Laws: A South Asian History
projects.organization: South Asian Studies Institute, University of the Fraser Valley
projects.description: An interactive timeline exploring the historical records of adversities, obstacles, and victories of the South Asian community in dealing with systemic prejudice in Canada.

projects.title: Job Unicorn Platform
projects.description: A decentralized platform for finding and hiring the best talent, connecting employers with skilled professionals through innovative blockchain-based solutions.
details: Advanced web scraping system for job data aggregation
RESTful APIs for enhanced analytics integration
Backend services with TypeScript and Golang

projects.title: Komagata Maru Educational Resources
projects.organization: South Asian Studies Institute, University of the Fraser Valley
projects.description: Educational web platform telling the story of Abbotsford citizens who supported the 346 Komagata Maru passengers' bid to legally reside in Canada, featuring lesson plans and historical documentation.

projects.title: South Asian Canadian Digital Archive (SACDA)
projects.organization: South Asian Studies Institute, University of the Fraser Valley
projects.description: A pan-Canadian digital archive documenting the history and heritage of the South Asian diaspora in Canada. Developed interactive exhibits and automated metadata management systems to preserve and share cultural heritage materials.

projects.title: Slap Game
projects.description: Built an interactive multiplayer slap battle game for nwHacks 2025, integrating MediaPipe for real-time facial and hand tracking alongside WebRTC for low-latency peer-to-peer video streaming.
details: Real-time facial and hand tracking with MediaPipe
Low-latency peer-to-peer video streaming with WebRTC
Solidity-based smart contracts for secure in-game wagers
Deployed via Hardhat with decentralised transactions support to enable players to also gamble.

projects.title: SustainSnap
projects.description: Spearheaded the development of SustainSnap, a mobile web application at the NWhacks UBC hackathon, designed to tackle environmental challenges through waste management. Integrated OpenAI's GPT-4 for image recognition, enabling users to accurately identify different types of garbage and receive guidance on correct disposal methods, promoting recycling and sustainability.
details: Mobile web application for waste management
Intuitive and responsive UI with SvelteKit and Tailwind CSS
OpenAI GPT-4 powered image recognition for garbage classification

projects.title: The Garden Platform
projects.description: The Garden is a creative platform where talents showcase their creativity and connect with fellow creatives. Developed interactive content and streamlined website management with automated solutions, increasing user engagement significantly.

projects.title: Union Zindabad! Digital Exhibit
projects.organization: South Asian Studies Institute, University of the Fraser Valley
projects.description: An interactive digital exhibit exploring South Asian labor history in Canada, featuring immersive storytelling and historical documentation through modern web technologies.
details: Enhanced user engagement through interactive content
Preservation of South Asian labor history

projects.title: zKare

details: Zero-knowledge proofs for secure, anonymous patient-researcher data sharing
Won The Graph Prize Pool at ETH Global Waterloo 2023
